ja.title: DLL3陽性CTCの判定に何個の細胞が必要か
ja.summary: Tarlatamab研究の公開CTC表20患者を再集計。20 mL換算数と実測分母を区別し、25%判定の条件付き精度と固定測定数の設計計算を示す。
ja.seo_title: DLL3陽性CTCの判定と必要な測定細胞数
ja.seo_description: Tarlatamab研究の公開CTC表を再集計。正規化数と実測分母を区別し、DLL3陽性割合25%の判定に対する測定数と過分散の影響を計算する。

en.title: How many CTCs are needed to classify DLL3 positivity?
en.summary: Public tarlatamab CTC data distinguish normalized counts from unknown denominators and quantify conditional precision around a 25% positivity threshold.
en.seo_title: DLL3-positive CTCs: counts and classification precision
en.seo_description: Public tarlatamab CTC data distinguish normalized counts from unknown denominators and quantify conditional precision around a 25% positivity threshold.

english.title: How many CTCs are needed to classify DLL3 positivity?
english.summary: Reanalysis of a public 20-patient tarlatamab CTC table. Conditional count-precision bounds and fixed-count design calculations separate normalized counts from unavailable raw denominators.
